description: Wastewater operational envelope for sentinel port attribution. 3 hazard profiles x fleet_crossed (3 ships) x R_onboard 1.0 x 34 wastewater cells = 4230 voyages. Core grid: 5 sampling intervals x 5 holding-tank residence times x 15 seeds, the interaction that decides whether the channel can separate consecutive port calls -- residence near the ~24 h inter-port interval smears a port-call spike across the next call, so cadence buys nothing once the tank has already mixed the signal. Depth (3 levels) and collection points (1 vs 3) are one-factor arms off the reference cell at 10 seeds. The clinical-only control cell is the baseline the coverage and CI-width gains are measured against. Hazards, ports, itineraries and dose calibration are inherited from sentinel_synthetic_recovery_v1 so the wastewater deltas are attributable to the sampling policy alone.

wastewater_scan.description: Sampling cadence and holding-tank residence are the two operational knobs; depth and collection points are the cost knobs whose returns are expected to saturate.

depth_sensitivity.description: Depth at the reference cadence, at a short and a long tank: precision should saturate, and should saturate sooner when residence has already destroyed the temporal structure.

collection_sensitivity.description: One aft main tap vs three distributed taps at the reference cell. Replicates from one epoch pool into a single trial, so extra taps buy spatial coverage rather than extra likelihood terms.

assay_sensitivity.description: Laboratory mode at the reference cell. The scan runs RT-qPCR everywhere else because it is the only mode that reports a quantitative concentration at the prevalences a cruise actually reaches; metagenomics is kept as an explicit arm to show it is blind there (~0.06 expected reads per 250k library at 0.26% shedder prevalence), and long-read is a confirmation rather than a cadence.

standard.description: 7-day western Caribbean: Cozumel, Costa Maya, George Town.

reversed.description: Same day slots, reversed port order (crossover on ordering).

staggered.description: Same port order, port calls one day earlier (crossover on timing).

one_hot.description: Cozumel a decade above background: the core detection question.

last_port_hot.description: Censoring stress cell: outbreak-scale hazard at the last port, where most onsets fall after disembarkation and wastewater is the only channel still observing.

null.description: No port hazard; every case is onboard secondary spread. False-attribution control for the wastewater channel.

fleet_crossed.description: Three ships, different port orders and timings: crossover identification.
